source_claims.quote: In Classical art he is usually represented as a beautiful winged youth.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani klasik, Eros lazim digambarkan sebagai pemuda bersayap.
statement.en: Classical art usually portrays Eros as a winged youth.

source_claims.quote: Eros is most often represented in Greek art as a carefree and beautiful youth, crowned with flowers, especially of roses which were closely associated with the god.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Eros paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar yang erat dikaitkan dengan sang dewa.
statement.en: In Greek art Eros is most often shown as a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses, which were closely associated with him.

source_claims.quote: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous but at other times he is cruel with his surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion

statement.id: Kadang sang dewa bermain-main dan jahil tanpa bahaya, tetapi di waktu lain ia kejam dengan serangan mendadak yang hanya membawa nafsu gegabah dan kebingungan.
statement.en: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous, but at other times cruel with surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion.

source_claims.quote: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Eros is usually depicted as an adolescent with wings and he often carries a wreath of victory.
source_claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno sejak abad ke-6 SM, Eros biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE Eros is usually depicted as a winged adolescent who often carries a victory wreath.

source_claims.quote: Surprisingly, he is only depicted carrying a bow with any great frequency from the 4th century BCE, although the first literary reference is much earlier and found in the tragedian Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).
source_claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Eros baru sering digambarkan membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM, meski rujukan sastra pertamanya jauh lebih awal, dalam Iphigenia in Aulis karya Euripides (sekitar 406 SM).
statement.en: Eros is shown carrying a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE, though the first literary reference is much earlier, in Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).

source_claims.quote: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of the gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.
